messages:
anya: FYI ran a small bring-up for q2b-int4 on the новом PromptSet cohort (short context, chained intents). seeing a cluster where 'create reminder' -> 'summarize note'.
tariq: ouch. minimal repro?
anya: single-shot prompt: "Create reminder: send an email to Alex tomorrow 10am". baseline/q8b -> reminder intent. q2b-int4 -> generates a summary sentence instead.
morgan: could be tokenization edge or quantized embedding bias. any logits/probs?
anya: attached a tiny diff snippet: ```
prob(reminder_token) baseline: 0.62 qint4: 0.41
prob(summarize_token) baseline: 0.03 qint4: 0.28
```
devin: that's a pretty big swap. did sampler de-dupe accidentally pair a summarization prompt with this sample?
anya: ran fingerprint check across seedbank+this cohort: 0 exact dup, 2 near-dups but neither is a summarization example.
tariq: sampling skew then? what's the length distribution compared to our golden evals?
anya: this cohort has 37% prompts <= 12 tokens vs typical 18%. lots more short actionable orders.
morgan: hypothesis: quant rounding on the final lm-head amplifies high-frequency tokens that correlate with summarization in our embedding space. need targeted int8/int4 head diffs.
devin: action items: (1) assemble failing sample list (<=20) and snapshot model diffs, (2) throw the set to label-ops for 3-rater quick consensus, (3) run int8 vs int4 head-only ablation.
anya: I'll assemble the sample list now and run the harness. command I'll run: `python small_harness.py --model=q2b-int4 --cohort=shortctx_chain --out=artifacts/1799912345.json`
infra-bot: deployed debug instance q2b-int4-debug-3 on gpu-node-7, will be ready in ~8m.
label-ops-bot: create ticket LO-9201 with attached samples once posted. label-ops team will triage.
morgan: also add a quick sampling tweak: bump long-context weight by 12% and re-run 1k sample smoke. if failure rate drops, we lean sampling. if not, it's quant/head.
tariq: timeline: try to get repro+labels in next 6 hours. if labels confirm regression, loop in research for kernel/quant-matrix adjustments.
anya: uploaded artifacts + initial diffs to the ticket LO-9201. posting the 14 failing sample ids below and attaching to the label-ops ticket. will update with harness results.
label-ops-bot: LO-9201 created and assigned to @label-ops. ETA 4h for consensus.
anya: thanks all. starting the int8/int4 head ablation now. will post updates here.
